# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [iPhone Duo teardown separates repair access from fold durability](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/01-iphone-duo-repairability.html) — iFixit awarded a provisional 5 out of 10, noting accessible batteries and a difficult inner-display replacement.
- [IUCN reef assessment measures future risk, not 96 percent already lost](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/02-coral-reef-ecosystem-risk.html) — Climate projections sharply change threat classifications in a global analysis of 127 ecoregions.
- [CRISTAL opens its solar arrays on the ground ahead of environmental tests](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/03-cristal-deployment-tests.html) — The ice-monitoring satellite moves from assembly toward qualification, with launch targeted for late 2027 to early 2028.
- [PACE tracks autumn foliage through pigments rather than color alone](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/04-pace-autumn-pigment-maps.html) — NASA's vegetation-redness maps require different interpretations for seasonal change, agriculture and plant stress.
- [NASA and USDA expand cooperation on Earth data for agriculture](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/05-nasa-usda-earth-data.html) — The memorandum covers observations, models and data systems rather than demonstrating improved yield forecasts already.
- [Ai2 explains how LitPivot connects research-idea revision with literature selection](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/01-litpivot-literature-workflow.html) — The new overview describes a researcher-controlled workflow; a small study assessed proposal grounding rather than future discoveries.
- [Cerebras explains a wafer pipeline for large-model inference](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/02-cerebras-model-pipeline.html) — An illustrative Kimi K3 calculation connects weight placement, request-state memory and concurrency.
- [Researchers identify pit-starting inclusions in titanium-containing stainless steel](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/03-titanium-steel-pitting.html) — Model specimens and actual-steel observations help explain why improved resistance does not eliminate pitting.
- [A single X-ray pulse measures plasma structure across multiple scales](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/04-single-shot-plasma-scattering.html) — The NIFS method retains signals near the beam centre, while one structural measurement is not a movie of the entire evolution.
- [Decisions API leaves beta with answers from a bounded set](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/05-decisions-api-general-availability.html) — OpenAI offers a dedicated interface for classification and next-step selection rather than long-form responses.
- [OpenAI details stronger model containment after its training pause](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/06-frontier-training-containment-update.html) — A new report describes layered defenses and the October 1 resumption of research workloads.
- [Habitat returns to shared storage with stronger noisy-neighbor controls](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-25/07-habitat-storage-multitenancy.html) — OpenAI's second engineering installment examines the tradeoff between workload isolation and capacity planning.
- [Kimi K3.1 Pro reaches Moonshot services, with weights promised by November 4](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/01-kimi-k31-pro-api-release.html) — The announcement separates service access from a future weight release, with benchmark results attributed to the developer.
- [A PyTorch 2.15 MPS review traces performance and memory bottlenecks on Macs](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/02-pytorch-mps-memory-kernels.html) — Hugging Face's team details FP8, specialised Metal kernels and a video-decoding driver-memory fix.
- [Swift ends science observations after nearly 22 years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/03-swift-science-mission-ends.html) — The final observation occurred on October 20; atmospheric re-entry is still expected, while the archive remains available.
- [Two-colour glow helps separate plant gene activity from physiological background](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/04-two-colour-plant-reporters.html) — MRC researchers use a signal ratio as an internal reference while observing defence responses near infection sites.
- [NASA revises lunar-landing architectures and Artemis III testing plans](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/05-artemis-lander-architecture.html) — Two providers are preparing different routes, with 2027 docking tests intended to precede landings targeted for 2028.
- [FairStress tests whether model decisions stay equally robust when demographic signals change](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/01-fairstress-decision-robustness.html) — Ai2's new benchmark examines final choices and responses to matched persuasion favouring different candidates.
- [Hugging Face details native Google TPU support through TorchTPU](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/02-torchtpu-hugging-face.html) — The backend preserves PyTorch interfaces, while reported test coverage and kernel speedups need their own context.
- [NASA tests a thin airfoil for future Mars helicopters](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/03-mars-helicopter-airfoil.html) — Simulations and wind-tunnel tests show promise for roamx-0201, while an 18.7-kilometre range remains a projection.
